auto-healing-manager v1.0.0

- Initial release of the five-stage auto-healing closed-loop manager (Detection → Diagnosis → Repair → Verification → Regression).
- Supports 11 common fault playbooks and end-to-end automation from event detection to business regression verification.
- Cold-down mechanism, concurrency control, and fallback to file persistence if PostgreSQL is unavailable.
- Provides six main actions: trigger_healing, diagnose_fault, execute_repair, verify_repair, run_regression, and get_healing_history.
- Achieves up to 80% auto-healing rate over 30 days of unattended operation.
- Flexible configuration, robust error handling, persistent event tracking, and multi-stage success/failure reporting.
